label: Video
description: Plays a video file -- or the person: src "speaker" is the film's speaker take (any position, size, shape, place in the stack; `background` room|blur|alpha picks the copy). Used for brand intros, outros, b-roll, a screencast, or the speaker.

src.label: Video Source
src.description: URL or path to the video file, or "speaker" for the film's speaker take

background.label: Background (speaker only)
background.description: For src "speaker": room (the raw take), blur (the room blurred), alpha (the person cut out; whatever lies under this component is the room)

shape.label: Shape
shape.description: rectangle (default), rounded, circle -- a bubble in a corner
